alex-finance: Heads-up: we resurfaced a billing variance cluster tied to delayed token ingestion. Roughly 18 customers show unexpected token shortfalls (~3-22%). Need a remediation owner for billing corrections and a clear timeline.

maria-billing: I'll run the remediation tracker. Need owner for the pipeline fix + reingest plan. @sam-platform?

sam-platform: I can own platform remediation (patch + reingest orchestration). Hypothesis: transient commit races in `ingest-processor` + a sanitizer change that altered dedupe keys.

jamie-sre: Observed repeated partial-commit traces around 04:12 UTC for the same batch window. We've throttled the runner and enabled stricter commit checks as a stop-gap. Latency back to normal.

lee-eng: I'll add an automated alert for "ledger-mismatch-rate" and a dashboard panel to show daily token diffs. ETA 36h. Also will add a unit test to prevent sanitizer from changing dedupe fields.

nora-ops: For customer-facing handling: propose auto-credit for deltas <$30 OR <6%, reissue otherwise. I'll draft messages and a CS playbook.

alex-finance: Agree with Nora's thresholds, but hold reissue >60 days pending legal. I'll assemble prioritized reissue queue after we get a verified ledger diff.

sam-platform: Plan: patch ingest runner (atomic commit + improved idempotence), canary in 4h, then run a dry reingest diff (sample first). Dry-run command: `python infra/scripts/ledger_diff.py --window 2024-06-10:2024-06-12 --dry-run`.

eng-ops-bot: eng-ops-bot: scheduled job `ledger-diff-dryrun` at 1777778200 by @sam-platform.

jamie-sre: After dry-run completes we'll do a 50-account reingest test and compare. If green, full reingest overnight. I'll post results here.

maria-billing: Action items captured: Sam = patch + reingest orchestration (4h patch, full reingest +24h), Lee = metric/dashboard (36h), Nora = CS templates & FAQ (48h), Alex = prioritization + legal gating (48h), Jamie = reingest testing & validation. Weekly sync cadence: Tue 11:00 PST until resolved.

sam-platform: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/5002 — includes atomic commit + idempotence test. Requesting reviews from @lee-eng @jamie-sre. Canary kicked off.

jamie-sre: Canary stable at 30m. Running dry diff now. Will post top-affected accounts in 20m.

maria-billing: I'll publish remediation tracker and invite stakeholders. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

alex-finance: Reminder: keep credits small and documented; escalate any ad-hoc credit >$150 to me.

nora-ops: Understood. I'll keep a ledger of credits issued and populate the tracker.

jamie-sre: Dry diff complete at 1777779400: found 18 accounts with token gaps, top 10 uploaded to incident doc. Starting 50-account test reingest at 1777779500.

sam-platform: Noted. Will watch test and prepare full window reingest if green.

maria-billing: Next check-in here after the 50-account test completes. Keep updates brief and include links to docs.
